_comment_overview: MCP Server Modernization: Official/community servers replace legacy tools/* where available. Tier 4 tools (no replacement) remain as custom implementations. Set env vars in .env or shell before starting. Runtime-fetched servers (npx/uvx/docker) pin an exact version or digest so launch does not resolve registry HEAD.

env._security_note: mcp-remote pinned to 0.1.49 (CVE-2025-6514 is fixed in 0.1.16+). Stay on 0.1.x; do not jump to 0.8.x.

mcpServers._comment_tier1: --- Tier 1: Official Vendor MCP Servers (replacing legacy tools/*) ---

env._setup_note: Microsoft Sentinel MCP (GA Nov 2025). Requires: (1) Onboarding to Microsoft Sentinel data lake, (2) Microsoft Entra OAuth. See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/datalake/sentinel-mcp-get-started
env._security_note: mcp-remote pinned to 0.1.49 (CVE-2025-6514 is fixed in 0.1.16+). Stay on 0.1.x; do not jump to 0.8.x.

env._setup_note: Splunk Official MCP Server. Deploy via Azure Marketplace (Splunk-hosted) or self-managed. See: https://www.splunk.com/en_us/blog/artificial-intelligence/unlocking-ai-driven-operations-with-splunk-mcp-server-on-azure-marketplace.html
env._security_note: mcp-remote pinned to 0.1.49 (CVE-2025-6514 is fixed in 0.1.16+). Stay on 0.1.x; do not jump to 0.8.x.

env._setup_note: Self-hosted Splunk via REST API. Set SPLUNK_URL (e.g., https://splunk.example.com:8089), SPLUNK_USERNAME, and SPLUNK_PASSWORD in .env. Port 8089 uses HTTPS by default.

Elastic Security via Elasticsearch REST API. Configure in Settings (elasticsearch URL, API key or username/password, optional Kibana URL). The tool reads via resolve(); there is no required env placeholder, so the server is not treated as dormant until those values exist.
Docker Hub only publishes latest for this image; the digest pins the multi-arch index so launch does not float.
Atlassian Rovo MCP Server (official). Covers Jira + Confluence + Compass. Uses OAuth 2.1 via browser flow. See: https://github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server
env._security_note: mcp-remote pinned to 0.1.49 (CVE-2025-6514 is fixed in 0.1.16+). Stay on 0.1.x; do not jump to 0.8.x.

env._setup_note: Clone first: git clone https://github.com/joesecurity/joesandboxMCP.git ~/mcp-servers/joesandboxMCP && cd ~/mcp-servers/joesandboxMCP && uv venv && uv pip install -e .

gcp-secops._comment: Pin mcp 1.x: this server uses the v1 mcp.server.fastmcp API, which mcp 2.x removed.

gcp-threat-intel._comment: Pin mcp 1.x: this server uses the v1 mcp.server.fastmcp API, which mcp 2.x removed.

gcp-scc._comment: Pin mcp 1.x: this server uses the v1 mcp.server.fastmcp API, which mcp 2.x removed.

env._setup_note: AWS Well-Architected Security Assessment MCP. Covers GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, IAM Access Analyzer. Requires AWS credentials. See: https://awslabs.github.io/mcp/servers/well-architected-security-mcp-server

env._note: Kept as custom tool. Consider consolidating with FastMCP ThreatIntel (multi-source: OTX + VT + AbuseIPDB + IPinfo) when available as a stable package.

mcpServers._comment_tier3_evaluate: --- Tier 3: Vendor MCP Exists But Scope Differs (evaluate) ---

env._note: Kept as custom tool. Prisma AIRS MCP (official, Jan 2026) focuses on securing AI agents, not PAN-OS firewall management. Evaluate if it covers block_ip/get_threats use cases.
Kept as custom tool. Slack Platform MCP Server (official, in development) focuses on app development, not SOC alerting. Monitor for slack_send_alert support.

mcpServers._comment_tier4: --- Tier 4: No Official/Community MCP Server (keep custom) ---

env._setup_note: CloudCurrent VStrike network topology fusion layer. Set VSTRIKE_BASE_URL and VSTRIKE_API_KEY in .env, or configure in Settings > Integrations.

env._note: Partially covered by Microsoft Sentinel MCP (shared Defender data lake). Evaluate if azure-sentinel entry above can replace this.
Microsoft Entra (Azure AD rebrand) may be accessible via Sentinel MCP or Okta MCP for identity use cases. Evaluate.

env._setup_note: MISP via REST API. Set MISP_URL and MISP_API_KEY (generate an Auth Key in the MISP UI) in .env; MISP_VERIFY_SSL=false for a local self-signed cert (defaults to verify). The tool loads all three from .env directly; only MISP_API_KEY gates dormancy, so the server stays dormant until it is set.

Cloudflare WAF, Zero Trust Gateway, and Access response actions plus read-only IP/domain threat lookups. Configure api_token (and optional account_id, zone_id) in Settings → Integrations. Tools are no-ops until the integration is enabled.
env._note: Cloudforce One threat-intel feeds are ingested separately by daemon/threat_feed_poller.py and enrich findings via daemon/processor.py — no MCP tool surface required for v1.
